profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Author: Node.js 8 the Right Way, Co-author: Seven Databases in Seven Weeks (both Published by the Pragmatic)

The world is getting better all the time, despite the negativity in the news. We collectively depend on the relentless pursuit of improvement. To that end, I never stop thinking, learning, and trying to better myself and my immediate environment.

I've been hacking since seventh grade when I got a TI-83 calculator. I was that guy writing the games the other kids would play during math class.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: JavaScript guru, problem manager, knowledge management developer, innovator, meddler.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer and MediaWiki Guru / community liaison.  Middle-tier development in PHP/MySQL. Frontend development in XHTMl/CSS/JS.  Backend/maintenance development in Python.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineering position.  Principle technologies were Ruby/Rails hitting MySQL database.  Great position - only left to pursue ground-level position with internet search startup Mahalo.com.  Would definitely work there again should circumstances permit.

positions.title: Programmer Analyist
positions.description: Software Developer position. Lots of Java/Spring/Hibernate and Perl-CGI.  Databases used were MySQL and MSSQL 2005.  Some C#.NET programming.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer and unofficial Build Guy.  Java/J2EE + Struts middle tier serving HTML/CSS/JS frontend.  Build systems used Ant and Maven - used Ruby for some build tasks.  Minor Eclipse plugin work.  Automation was managed by CruiseControl, later by Continuum.  Databases used were Oracle 9i.  Webservers used were IBM WebSphere 6.0+ and Oracle Application Server 10.1.2 and 10.1.3.  LDAP services used included Oracle Internet Directory and Microsoft Active Directory.
